title: Chapter 198: What Color Do You Prefer?
html:
At the corridor’s center, both the mannequin’s legs had been torn away. The rope around its neck drew tight as though an invisible hand were pulling it.

What is this guy trying to achieve?

The Tape Ghost had fallen silent upon reaching the body. The more Chen Ge considered it, the less he understood.

The mannequin is the item of possession for Xu Zhenzhen, so the Tape Ghost is trying to force her out?

As he thought, the rope snapped. The mannequin crashed to the floor, its head breaking free and rolling several yards before stopping in a corner, eyes fixed on the abandoned body.

The crudely fashioned face shifted from struggle to terror, then slowly returned to normal. Its false lips moved as though trying to speak. Seconds later, screams filled the corridor again—now joined by a woman’s voice.

“So painful! So painful!”

Male and female voices circled Chen Ge, their combined screams deeply unsettling him.

Why is Xu Zhenzhen screaming alongside the Tape Ghost? Does he have the ability to assimilate other ghosts?

Whatever the Tape Ghost had done to Xu Zhenzhen remained its greatest secret. Alternating male and female cries flooded Chen Ge’s ears, making his eyelids twitch. He tried to stop the recorder, but the controls refused to respond.

“Pain, so much pain…”

The voice seemed to brush his face, then gradually weakened. The recorder clicked, and the play button released.

The oppressive weight lifted from the corridor, allowing Chen Ge to breathe more easily. Even the mannequin head on the floor looked less frightening. He opened the recorder, and as he removed the cassette, the black phone vibrated.

A message at a time like this?

Chen Ge stood beside the female mannequin and took out his phone to take a look.

“Congratulations, Specter’s Favored. You have unlocked Xu Yin’s affection mission. Completing the affection mission will greatly increase Xu Yin’s affection level, and there’s a high chance that you might be able to employ him at your Haunted House!

“Mission Venue: Fang Hwa Apartments.

“Mission Goal: You only have one night to find Xu Yin’s lover!

“Mission Hint: Honey, white, black, and red, which color do you prefer?”

Though the message contained only a few lines, Chen Ge read it several times.

Fang Hwa Apartments? Isn’t that where Wang Xin is staying? I’ve been there once when I was trying to help the Pen Spirit.

Every mission from the black phone carried danger. The Tape Ghost’s profound resentment also implied a terrible death. Chen Ge had no desire to accept another mission immediately after surviving the Third Sick Hall, but the chance to employ a ghost was too valuable to surrender.

The Tape Ghost is slightly stronger than the Pen Spirit. If I can hire him, then doing Trial Missions in the future will be safer.

The moment he decided, his other phone rang. The number was unfamiliar.

There are only a few who know my number. Who could this be?

He let it ring several times before answering.

“Chen Ge, this is Captain Yan.”

“Captain Yan? Why are you calling?”

“Of the three suspects you found at the Third Sick Hall… two have been discovered dead in their homes.”

“Dead?!” Chen Ge was shocked.

Before he could ask for details, the black phone vibrated in his other hand. A new message announced that the Third Sick Hall’s completion rate had risen to sixty-five percent.

“Chen Ge? Are you there?”

“Sorry, just a little shocked. They were fine a few days ago; why did they suddenly die?”

“At 3:00 a.m. yesterday, we received a call from someone identifying himself as Xu Tong. He said several strange, incoherent things, and the officer couldn’t understand what he was trying to communicate.”

“So, you hung up on him?”

“Of course not. Xu Tong was a fugitive. The officer notified us immediately, but by the time we triangulated the call and reached him, he was dead.” An almost imperceptible emotion entered Captain Yan’s voice. “He and a one-armed man had been stuffed into a cabinet. We don’t yet know the cause of death, and neither body bore obvious wounds.”

“Perhaps the killer is their former ally? The man’s name is Xiong Qing. His face is twisted, so he’s easily recognizable.”

“Leave the investigation to us. I asked Inspector Lee for your number because I wanted to warn you personally.” Captain Yan sent two photographs. “We found these on the victims’ phones. Their group may be targeting you.”

The images loaded slowly. The first showed Chen Ge being placed in the police car outside the Third Sick Hall; the second captured him leaving the station. Both were blurry, taken from a great distance by an extremely cautious observer.

“Xu Tong took these?” Chen Ge had never imagined himself becoming the target of a stalker.

“That no longer matters. What matters is that they appear to belong to something larger—an organized group. That changes everything.”

“I told you that morning there might be eight killers, all former Third Sick Hall patients.” Apart from Wang Shenglong, every patient had been deemed incurable.

Captain Yan sighed. “Your information helped enormously. We reviewed records from four years ago and found that three of those eight patients effectively vanished after the hospital closed. They left no physical or digital trail.”
